integrity: Same-side crown pairs force at least three omitted vertices in the opposite part. Those two side conditions also guarantee a matched-pair length-three geodesic whose internal vertices are omitted. Independent choices across the two parts yield the squared truncated-binomial polynomial.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns total mutual visibility only.
The empty set is counted in the polynomial convention; at n=3 it is the only feasible set.
The balanced complete-bipartite total visibility polynomial is prior work and is used only for comparison.
Finite exhaustive verification through n=8 is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed crown result may exist.
title: Total visibility polynomial of crown graphs
